title: kate-syntax: list every vendored definition in vendored.rs
summary: Add vendored.rs with the VENDORED list of include_str entries and vendored_repository, which parses and links every entry. The list starts with the six early files. Repository gains definition_count. lib.rs exports the list and the function. The test module in repository.rs keeps its own six-entry list. Each later wiring packet adds one entry to VENDORED.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the Framework machine codes this packet in the ~/code/KateM5Rust-wire worktree. kate-syntax builds and tests on Linux. No macOS tool is needed. A Cursor cloud agent may take the packet when the Framework lane is busy.

definitions.definition:
/// Parse and link every entry of `VENDORED`.
pub fn vendored_repository() -> Result<Repository, LoadError>

mod vendored;
pub use vendored::{VENDORED, vendored_repository};

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create crates/kate-syntax/src/vendored.rs with the SPDX copyright line and the MIT license line that gatecheck requires. VENDORED holds the six early files in the order rust, comments, alert, modelines, spdx-comments, ansic89. vendored_repository calls Repository::empty, add_xml for each entry with ?, then link with ?, and returns the repository. Add pub fn definition_count to Repository in repository.rs. It returns self.definitions.len(). Do not change any other function in repository.rs. Do not change the VENDORED const inside repository::tests. That test module keeps its own list and six_vendored_definitions_load_and_link stays green. In lib.rs add mod vendored and the pub use line. Keep the other exports. vendored.rs gets one test module named tests. The test every_vendored_definition_loads_and_links calls vendored_repository, asserts definition_count equals VENDORED.len(), and for each DefId from 0 to that count asserts the license is MIT and Highlighter::new returns Ok. Do not nest an if inside an if. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 80 lines.

regression_tests.name: vendored::tests::every_vendored_definition_loads_and_links
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because vendored.rs does not exist. After the change vendored_repository links six definitions, each has license MIT, and Highlighter::new is Ok for each DefId.
